options.text: A heavily quantised/distilled model running fully on-device

items.stem: Why plan over-the-air (OTA) model updates for edge deployments?

options.text: Models need fixes and retraining over time; devices must be updatable safely
options.rationale: Correct: an update path is essential for the model lifecycle at the edge.

options.text: Models on the edge never need changing
options.rationale: They do, as data and requirements change.

options.text: OTA updates improve the camera lens
options.rationale: OTA updates software/models, not hardware optics.

options.text: It removes the need for compression
options.rationale: Compression is still needed to fit the device.

items.explanation: Correct: an update path is essential for the model lifecycle at the edge.
